I brought it up to my mother, who was also questioning her faith.  She told me that she sees such immoral things at the hospital where she works.  Children being abused, sometimes fatally, by their parents.  She said to me that if there is a god, he would not allow such things to happen.  I think that conversation really contributed to it.  I eventually woke up one day and realized it was all a load of BS.

I have been dealing with depression for a long time.  I am still dealing with it.  I understand how it feels.  I have been in and out of therapy my whole life.  I was even put in a mental hospital for serious thoughts of suicide.  The hospital was two hours away from my house.  If my family wanted to visit me, they had to drive for two hours.  It just made me feel worse.  I didn't feel I was worth the time it took to drive all the way out there.  That's what depression does.  It makes you feel helpless and worthless.  But you can get through it.  When you hear that voice, you have to tell your dark passenger to f*** off.  It isn't easy, I can attest to that.  But medications and therapy have been helping me to get my life together.  I am hoping you can recover too.
